name: roundabout
author: netmod demo (artkit + lanekit + multitile, unified by task roundabout)
description: A 2x2 one-way mini roundabout as ONE new piece id, 20400, used in four states (pinwheel 3,0 / 2,1), with four exits. Behaves as road T 39 (exemplar, cost) except for its own lanes. Art: built at install time by recipe.json (netart.py compose: ring = stock curve 11203, exit = stock straight 29), no game art in the package. Lanes: quarter.lanes.json (street-sim lanes one way round the ring, turn matrix from those lanes). Placement: template 'rotonda' with the On-ramp tool in template mode (sc3netmod, keys T / R), protected cells, demolished as one block. layout.json is the netart preview of the block with roads on the exits.
